quizzes.title: Ancient Games and Modern Revival
quizzes.passage:
The Olympic Games have a history that begins in ancient Greece, where the early Games were held at Olympia. Records of the last ancient Games are found in the history books, which shows that the tradition lasted for a long time before it came to an end.

The ancient Games were later brought to an end by an order that also targeted Greek temples and statues of gods. The ban was part of an effort to promote Christianity across the empire.

The modern Olympic movement took shape in the late nineteenth century. A founder led its revival, and an international committee was set up to organise the movement. The first modern international event was held in a Greek city, after a royal announcement that the Games would begin again.

The modern movement is now governed by an international body based in Switzerland. Over the years, the Olympics have had to adapt to changing times, and some editions were disrupted by global conflicts. India first took part in the Olympics in an early edition, and it first sent a team to the Summer Games at a later date. Indian athletes have also competed at a Winter Games held in Austria. Italy has hosted the Olympic Games on several occasions, including the Winter Games in Cortina in 1956, and Rome hosted the Summer Games in 1960.

questions.q:

Reason (R): Women first took part in the Olympic Games at the 1900 Paris Olympics.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Women first took part in 1900, so the assertion about the 1896 Athens event is false while the reason is true.

questions.explanation: The ancient Games began in 776 BCE, the Athens event was in 1896, the WWI cancellation was in 1916, and the IOC was established in 1894.

questions.explanation: Statement II is wrong because the IOC was established in 1894, while I and III are correct.

questions.explanation: Statement II is wrong because the first modern international event was held at Athens in 1896, while I and III are correct.

quizzes.title: Olympic Bodies and India's Sports Schemes
quizzes.passage:
The Olympic motto, Citius, Altius, Fortius, sums up the competitive spirit that the global movement celebrates. Within India, several government programmes have been created to support sport at different levels. Khelo India is one such effort, and it is concerned with identifying and developing athletes at both grassroots and elite levels. Its winter edition was planned for Ladakh and Jammu & Kashmir.

The national sports policy aims to enhance the quality of sports training, promote participation, and increase the number of athletes competing internationally. Doping remains a serious concern for sport. A 2023 report by the World Anti-Doping Agency found that India had the highest positivity rate for banned substances among major nations, and the Athletics Integrity Unit also recorded doping offences involving Indian athletes in track and field.

India has a long record of participation in the Games. It first took part in an early edition, first sent a team to the Summer Games at a later date, and has competed at a Winter Games held in Austria. The Milano Cortina Winter Games in 2026 were held in Italy, in the cities of Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo.

questions.explanation: The Fit India Movement, launched in 2019, encourages mass participation in fitness activities.
